items.text: All four round-001 decisions were incorporated into plan.md: d1=C (hybrid Go integration test + manual smoke plan), d2=A (Go test inside scenarios/swarm-manager/api/internal/backlog/), d3=A (TEST-PLAN.md colocated with skill plus one-line pointer in SKILL.md), d4=C (both Go data-seam test for clarification HTTP contract AND manual UX walkthrough). The Implementation Strategy section captures these in a Decision Summary table near the top so the executing agent does not need to re-read round-001 to recover intent.

Plan now covers all previously-missing canonical sections: Purpose, Problem Statement, Current Technical Context, Target End State, Implementation Strategy (phased), Contract Decisions, Testing Plan, Rollout/Validation Checklist, Definition of Done. Validation warnings addressed: explicit Greenfield Constraint section near the top, and Phase 3 ends with `vrooli scenario restart swarm-manager` plus a health-check verification.

Initiative-context audit: workshop-decision-triage has zero upstream and zero downstream initiatives. The three execute siblings (priority-sort+CLI, prep agent, sync skill) are archived; this chore is the only remaining member. No cross-initiative ripple. Sibling-overlap audit returned no candidates for `Update backlog item` reuse — both deliverables (Go integration test, manual TEST-PLAN.md) are net-new. Once this chore lands, the initiative is shippable.

Greenfield invariant is asserted explicitly. Definition of Done item 8 makes it a checkable gate: no compatibility shims, no dead code, no unused re-exports, no `// removed` comments, no renamed `_unused` variables. The Phase-1 location decision (d2=A) was chosen specifically to avoid widening acceptance_allow or re-exporting private helpers — the Non-Goals section pins both as prohibited.
All five readiness dimensions scored 3/3. No remaining gaps. Plan is ready for execution; recommend marking status=ready and queueing.
